title: Add a Rating Gate to the Trend Brief
summary: Before each weekly trend brief is finalized, require a concise owner rating for every included play and flag unrated items for follow-up. This improves the existing inventory’s usability without changing content scope or distribution.

statusHistory.reason: VAULT novel: Introduces a pre-publication quality gate requiring owner ratings on trend brief plays with flagging mechanism. No prior candidate addresses rating validation as a finalization control.
